mechanism: Prochlorperazine (dopamine antagonist) may antagonize the therapeutic effects of lisdexamfetamine (dopamine/norepinephrine agonist), while amphetamines can potentiate antipsychotic-induced cardiac arrhythmias and increase CNS excitation risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor closely for reduced amphetamine efficacy, cardiac arrhythmias, and excessive CNS stimulation.
